title: 7 Ways a Godly Man's Wallet Proves Where His Heart Is
caption:
For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also (Matthew 6:21). Not a verse about your feelings. A verse about your bank statement.

7 ways a godly man's wallet tells on him before he ever opens his mouth.

What you can't account for, you're not actually stewarding. What you hide from your brothers is usually what's discipling you.

A steward plans. An owner just spends.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #stewardship #generosity
